items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Another time, another a friend of mine... we was learnin' how to play together, we was studyin' together

ctx.x: Another time, another a friend of mine, he went overboard. But, one thing, I never did go overboard. But this fellow went overboard, and we took him home, we were all kids and we was afraid to let his people know it, so we stood him up on the steps and we told him to hold on to the doorknob and we rang the bell and run. So, when he come to the door, they find him out there, and that didn't work in my favor because, after all, she, his mother, told him, "See here, I want you to stay away from that old Sammy Wood…
So then we went on through high school.
